target_mapping.signal_rule: Enter when QQQ > MA200 and MA20 slope is positive; continue risk while already active and QQQ > MA200; below MA200 pullback re-entry additionally requires QQQ > MA20, positive MA20 slope, and 20-session volatility-scaled rebound > 2.0x recent daily-return volatility.
